main_body: Sci-fi control tower on a wide base: a hipped roof and window drum at the top, a narrow stem, then a sloped base roof over a front wall with double doors
top_band: Center column: orange cap at rows 0-1 and antenna at rows 2-7. Then a light blue-grey sloped roof at rows 8-17, brightest at rows 15-17. The lower base has a second sloped roof of panelled blue-grey at rows 52-62.
evidence: Both the tower roof (rows 8-17) and the base roof (rows 52-62) read as lighter sloped trapezoid surfaces seen from above. A pale edge band at rows 15-17 and 60-62 marks the front edge. Dark rows sit directly below it: the shaded window band at rows 18-19 and the dark wall top at rows 63-64. The window drum (rows 18-29) and the door wall (rows 63-79) are the front faces. The doors and windows sit inside dark frames, so they read as inset. A top band and a front face are both clearly drawn, so it passes.

style.evidence: The roofs have about 4 blue-grey steps, but they are broad smooth panels with no per-tile or grain detail, unlike the reference's scalloped tile roofs and speckled plaster and stone. The outer outline is near-black and neutral all the way round, which gives a sticker look. The stem, the lower wall and the door-wall flanks are large flat dark or grey fills with little variation. Tiles are mostly 2-4 colours, far below the reference's richness.
